description: Complete Class 11 & 12 NCERT Physics chapter summaries (28 chapters).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: SI base units, dimensional analysis, significant figures, and error propagation. Planck's constant h and angular momentum L share dimensions [ML²T⁻¹].

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Kinematics equations for uniform acceleration: v = u + at, s = ut + (1/2)at², v² = u² + 2as. Area under v-t graph gives displacement; slope gives acceleration.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Vector addition, projectile motion (R = u² sin(2θ)/g, H = u² sin²θ/(2g), T = 2u sinθ/g), and uniform circular motion centripetal acceleration ac = v²/r.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Newton's laws: F = dp/dt = ma, impulse J = Δp, conservation of linear momentum, static friction fs ≤ μs N, kinetic friction fk = μk N, banked road vmax = √(rg tanθ).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Work W = F·s cosθ, Work-Energy Theorem Wnet = ΔKE, conservation of mechanical energy, elastic vs inelastic collisions, power P = F·v.

passages.subject: physics
passages.chapter_title: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
passages.content: Centre of mass, torque τ = r × F = Iα, angular momentum L = Iω, parallel axis theorem I = Icm + Md², solid sphere I = (2/5)MR², hollow sphere I = (2/3)MR².

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Newton's law F = Gm₁m₂/r², acceleration due to gravity g = GM/R², orbital velocity vo = √(GM/R), escape velocity ve = √(2GM/R) ≈ 11.2 km/s on Earth, Kepler's laws (T² ∝ r³).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Hooke's law: Stress = E × Strain, Young's modulus Y = FL/(AΔL), bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, elastic potential energy per unit volume u = (1/2) × stress × strain.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Pascal's law, Archimedes' principle, continuity equation A₁v₁ = A₂v₂, Bernoulli's equation P + (1/2)ρv² + ρgh = constant, Stokes' law F = 6πηrv, surface tension & capillary rise.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Thermal expansion (α, β=2α, γ=3α), calorimetry Q = mcΔT, latent heat Q = mL, conduction dQ/dt = kAΔT/L, Wien's displacement law λm T = b, Stefan-Boltzmann law E = σT⁴.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: First law ΔQ = ΔU + ΔW, isothermal work W = nRT ln(V₂/V₁), adiabatic PV^γ = const, Mayer's relation Cp - Cv = R, Carnot efficiency η = 1 - Tc/Th.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Ideal gas PV = nRT, pressure P = (1/3)ρ v²rms, vrms = √(3RT/M), equipartition of energy (1/2)kBT per degree of freedom, mean free path λ = 1/(√2 π d² n).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Simple Harmonic Motion: a = -ω²x, T = 2π√(m/k) for spring, T = 2π√(L/g) for simple pendulum, total energy E = (1/2)kA².

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Wave speed v = fλ, transverse wave on string v = √(T/μ), speed of sound v = √(γRT/M), organ pipes (open fn = nv/2L, closed odd harmonics), beats fbeat = |f₁ - f₂|.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Coulomb's law F = k|q₁q₂|/r² (k = 9×10⁹ N·m²/C²), electric field E = F/q, dipole torque τ = pE sinθ, Gauss's law Φ = q_enclosed/ε₀.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Potential V = kq/r, E = -dV/dr, parallel plate capacitor C = ε₀A/d, dielectric C' = KC, series 1/Ceq = Σ1/Ci, parallel Ceq = ΣCi, stored energy U = (1/2)CV².

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Ohm's law V = IR, drift velocity I = neAvd, resistivity ρ = m/(ne²τ), Kirchhoff's junction & loop rules, Wheatstone bridge balance P/Q = R/S, internal resistance V = E - Ir.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Lorentz force F = q(E + v × B), Biot-Savart law, circular loop center B = μ₀I/(2R), solenoid B = μ₀nI, force per unit length between parallel wires F/L = μ₀I₁I₂/(2πd).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Bar magnet dipole moment m = NIA, torque τ = mB sinθ, diamagnetic (χ < 0), paramagnetic (χ > 0 small), ferromagnetic (χ >> 1).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Faraday's law ε = -dΦB/dt, Lenz's law (conservation of energy), motional emf ε = Blv, self-inductance ε = -L(dI/dt), inductor energy U = (1/2)LI².

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: RMS values Irms = I₀/√2, inductive reactance XL = ωL, capacitive reactance XC = 1/(ωC), LCR impedance Z = √(R² + (XL - XC)²), resonance ω₀ = 1/√(LC), transformer Vs/Vp = Ns/Np.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Displacement current Id = ε₀(dΦE/dt), transverse nature E ⊥ B ⊥ direction of propagation, speed c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀) = E₀/B₀, EM spectrum from radio to gamma rays.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Mirror formula 1/v + 1/u = 1/f, Snell's law n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r, total internal reflection sin ic = 1/n, lens maker's formula, power P = 1/f(m), prism δm = (n-1)A.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Huygens' principle, Young's Double Slit Experiment fringe width β = λD/d, constructive Δx = nλ, destructive Δx = (n+1/2)λ, single-slit diffraction, Brewster's law tan ip = n.

passages.subject: physics
passages.chapter_title: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
passages.content: Photoelectric effect Kmax = hν - φ₀ = eV₀, threshold frequency ν₀ = φ₀/h, de Broglie wavelength λ = h/p = h/√(2mK).

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Rutherford nuclear model, Bohr's postulates: L = nh/(2π), radius rn = 0.529 n²/Z Å, energy En = -13.6 Z²/n² eV, Lyman (UV), Balmer (visible), Paschen (IR) series.

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Nuclear radius R = R₀ A^(1/3), mass defect Δm and binding energy Eb = Δm c², nuclear fission vs fusion, mass-energy equivalence E = mc².

passages.subject: physics
passages.content: Intrinsic vs extrinsic (n-type pentavalent, p-type trivalent) semiconductors, p-n junction diode forward/reverse bias, half-wave & full-wave rectifiers, logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR).
